principles: Fail closed rather than manufacture proof.
Keep Layer 2 proof separate from Authority and higher-layer claims.
Use fresh, isolated .lattice artifacts and explicit material binding.
Resolve F-009 only with evidence, not prose.
drivers: F-009 is currently a high suspected audit finding blocking convergence.
Existing formal evaluator is LOCKED on stale/incomplete artifacts.
User asked for two-host auditor-led execution under four anti-bloat principles.

options.name: A: Execute the existing F-009 evidence-closure plan without code semantic changes
pros: Directly addresses the suspected finding with fresh artifacts and negative controls
Avoids arbitrary optimization or weakening proof semantics
Can honestly resolve, verify, or retain F-009 based on evidence
cons: May still end with F-009 open if required proof inputs are unavailable
Requires careful artifact hygiene and repeated freshness checks

options.name: B: Modify formal proof code now to force Layer 2 unlock
pros: Could make a green result quickly if the implementation were truly missing
cons: Risks optimizing before confirming the gap

options.name: C: Leave F-009 open with only the existing plan document
cons: Does not satisfy convergence or user request
Leaves high suspected gap without closure evidence

chosen: A: Execute the existing F-009 evidence-closure plan without code semantic changes
rationale: Choose the evidence-closure path because the current source already has formal proof machinery, but the active blocker is missing fresh proof artifacts and closure evidence, not an established need to change semantics.

preMortem.scenario: False unlock from stale or mixed artifacts
preMortem.trigger: The suite scans a shared artifact root containing old baseline reports
preMortem.consequence: Layer 2 claim could appear unlocked from stale evidence
preMortem.mitigation: Use a clean .lattice artifact root and run stale/mismatch negative controls

preMortem.scenario: Authority overclaim from local host review
preMortem.trigger: Claude/Codex verdict text is treated as receipt proof
preMortem.consequence: F-009 is falsely closed and production authority is implied
preMortem.mitigation: Record host verdicts only as localNonAuthorityAudit and keep receiptVerified/productionDone/fullAuthorityDone false

preMortem.trigger: Only a subset of ENG baselines gets formal final reports
preMortem.consequence: F-009 closure is incomplete and convergence is misleading
preMortem.mitigation: Require all nine ENG baseline reports and formal evaluator output before resolving F-009

preMortem.trigger: Executor starts changing proof semantics before reproducing the failure
preMortem.mitigation: Only edit code if a verified correctness gap remains after source and artifact inventory
